title: Unveiling the nexus: exploring the relationship of e-satisfaction, e-trust, and online repurchase intentions among students in a developing country
core_idea: Investigate how e-trust and e-customer satisfaction relate to online repurchase intention among university students in Bangladesh, examining e-trust and e-satisfaction as mediators and prior online experience as a moderator using a quantitative online survey (N=415) analyzed with SEM and a simultaneous 2SLS approach.
tldr: A quantitative study probing relationships among e-trust, e-customer satisfaction, and online repurchase intentions of Bangladeshi students, testing mediation by trust/satisfaction and moderation by prior online experience using SEM and 2SLS on survey data.
